Context
Football fans are at their most emotionally 
engaged during live matches — especially 
during EPL Big Match nights, where viewing 
peaks and late-night hunger naturally occurs.
This creates a prime opportunity for LINE MAN to 
connect with consumers at the exact moment of 
need and drive real consumption.
Idea
LINE MAN transformed football passion into a matchday 
habit through an integrated 3-layer promo code strategy:
MATCHDAY (Always-on)
Available throughout the season as a go-to code
BIG MATCH (Time-limited)
Activated during key fixtures to drive urgency
POST-MATCH (Emotional)
Codes tied to match outcomes to extend engagement
Challenge
Before sponsorship, LINE MAN’s user base 
was predominantly female, driven by price 
comparison behavior.The challenge was to 
penetrate the male-dominated football 
audience at scale and transform passive 
viewers into active users not just awareness, 
but conversion during match time.
Integrated promo codes within 
live broadcast moments
MAKE THE CODE AS A PART OF 
FOOTBALL EXPERIENCES
